about: One of the original blends from the late Henry "Don Kiki" Berger, now made by Karen Berger's company in Esteli. Today it is sold as a short 4 1/2 x 54 figurado with binder and filler from the family's Nicaraguan farm.
notes: The maker only says the wrapper is Ecuadorian; Neptune calls it Ecuadorian Criollo over a Corojo binder. Neptune rates the strength Full and describes the body as medium to full. A barber pole version (maduro and Connecticut wrappers, same size) was added in 2023.
